Options:
  -p, --patch  Interactively select changes
  -S, --staged  Store only staged changes
  -k, --keep-index  Keep staged changes in the worktree
  --no-keep-index  Revert staged changes
  -u, --include-untracked  Include untracked files
  -a, --all  Include ignored files
  -m, --message MESSAGE  Set the stash description
  -q, --quiet  Suppress progress messages
  --pathspec-from-file FILE  Read pathspecs from a file
  --pathspec-file-nul  Use NUL-separated pathspecs
